observations: Historical dialogue testimony resolves private witness authority into emitted claim fragments and verifies their sequence and text; investigation options bind a session, character, party, source scope, revision, objective and intended recipient, rejecting ambiguous candidate objectives.

Effects recheck live presence, leadership, pre-issued binding, generated provenance and custody version before advancing a case. Organization interactions resolve an exact local representative; selected contract actions recheck the issuer. Custody, receipt and transaction behavior require connected caller review.

Topic selection and prompt answers require the strategic gateway and session membership; answers check respondent, choices and policy. Their retry checks differ: topic selection returns success on an existing session/action ID without comparing the action kind, while an answer compares the prompt identity. Current body, supported conflicting retries and consequences are not established here.

The historical implementation uses count-to-u32 event sequences, raw action/source coordinates and both saturating and ordinary session revision increments. Their capacity, admission and exhaustion paths remain open; no test or fixture was executed.
